{{Short description|Russian theoretical physicist}}
{{BLP primary sources|date=March 2014}}

'''Alex Kamenev''' is a [[theoretical physics|theoretical physicist]], at the [[William I Fine Theoretical Physics Institute, University of Minnesota]], specializing in [[condensed matter]]. Kamenev's current research focuses on [[theoretical condensed matter physics]], disordered systems and glasses, field-theoretical treatment of many-body systems, mesoscopic systems, out of equilibrium systems. Kamenev earned his M.Sci. degree [[theoretical physics]], in 1987 from [[Moscow State University]] and a Ph.D. in [[solid-state physics]], in 1996 from [[Weizmann Institute of Science]] in Israel.<ref>[https://www.physics.umn.edu/people/kamenev.html UMN BIO Physics Kamenev]</ref>

== Honors and awards  ==
Kamenev was elected a [[fellow]] of the [[American Physical Society]] in 2013;<ref>[https://www.physics.umn.edu/about/awards.html UMN Physics Awards list]</ref> elected an Alfred P. [[Sloan Research Fellow]] from 2004 to 2008;<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.sloan.org/sloan-research-fellowships/past-fellows/ |title=Alfred P. Sloan Past Fellows |access-date=2014-03-03 |archive-date=2016-11-06 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161106043224/http://www.sloan.org/sloan-research-fellowships/past-fellows/ |url-status=dead }}</ref><ref>[https://www.physics.umn.edu/about/awards.html UMN Physics Awards List]</ref> and was awarded the McKnight Land-Grant Professorship for the years of 2005–2007.<ref>[http://www.physics.umn.edu/alumni/Newsletter5.pdf SPA Newsletter 2005]</ref><ref>[https://www.physics.umn.edu/people/kamenev.html UMN BIO Physics Kamenev]</ref>

== Publications ==
He is the author of a book, ''Field Theory of Non-Equilibrium Systems'',<ref>[http://www.cambridge.org/us/academic/subjects/physics/condensed-matter-physics-nanoscience-and-mesoscopic-physics/field-theory-non-equilibrium-systems#contents Cambridge University Press]</ref> Cambridge University Press (2011) and a   number of journal articles. His most cited article, cited 589 times according to [[Google Scholar]]<ref>[https://scholar.google.com/scholar?hl=en&q=Alex+Kamenev&btnG=&as_sdt=1%2C33&as_sdtp= Google Scholar]</ref>    is Boris L. Altshuler, Yuval Gefen, Alex Kamenev, and Leonid S. Levitov "Quasiparticle Lifetime in a Finite System: A Nonperturbative Approach" published in 2003 in vol. 78 of  ''[[Physical Review Letters]]'' <ref>[https://arxiv.org/abs/cond-mat/9609132 Condensed Matter Archive]</ref>
